title: Monotonicity of biased probability
statement: Let $\rho$ be real with $0\leq \rho\leq 1$, let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $A$ and $B$ be predicates on Boolean strings. If every string of length $m$ satisfying $A$ also satisfies $B$, then the biased probability of $A$ is at most the biased probability of $B$.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ and $B$ are predicates on Boolean strings
for every string $w$ of length $m$, $A(w)$ implies $B(w)$
